openMeteoArm.note: Third serving source (user decision 2026-11-01): Open-Meteo ecmwf_ifs025, covering only the windows beyond the GRIB step-240 ceiling. Open-Meteo publishes no cycle metadata and the E1 parity check could not cycle-verify its forecast instance against the GRIB arm, so this arm is labelled distinctly and keeps its own evidence clock. Reduced-feature variant: total column liquid water is unavailable from Open-Meteo, so tclw_pwt / tclw_max are NaN under the validated pass-through.
